units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 59b:5">Ab. Zar. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>דאישתקיל ברזיה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דאישתקיל לברזא</he>) whose bung was taken out.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 59b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>כל דלהדי ב׳</he> all the wine facing the bung-hole (the first gush of wine).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 60a:1">Ib. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>עד דב׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>הב׳</he>, Rashi <he>ב׳</he>) to a level with &c., i.e. the wine above the bung-hole.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 98a:9">B. Bath. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>שני בב׳</he> (Ms. H. <he>בברזָהּ</he>) changed the bung-hole (or the bung).
